lockFileMaintenance.description: The weekly refresh moves the packages the relay's own packages depend on, which are in its bundle, so a person merges it

xcode.description: Xcode's releases, from the feed the xcodes tool uses. Betas and release candidates are left out

customManagers.description: The Xcode the Makefile builds with

packageRules.description: A new Xcode has to be installed on every Mac that builds Hermes before its update merges, and it changes the compiler and the SDK
prBodyNotes: Install this Xcode with `xcodes install` on this branch, then run `make check`, `make test`, and `make build`.

packageRules.description: A merge under relay/ deploys the relay. The packages its code imports are in the bundle tenants are told they can check, so a person merges their updates
Wrangler builds the relay's bundle, so its updates change the bundle too
The actions in the relay's deploy and verify workflows build, attest, and check the bundle, so a person merges their updates
Swift packages never merge on their own. No workflow builds the app, and PROBLEMS.md ties several versions to copied files and to behavior a person checks
prBodyNotes: Renovate changes `Package.swift` only. Run `swift package resolve` on this branch and commit `Package.resolved`, then run `make check` and `make test`. [PROBLEMS.md](../blob/main/PROBLEMS.md) lists what else to do for a grammar with a copied scanner and for `libghostty-spm`.

packageRules.description: tree-sitter-swift's plain tags omit the generated parser and don't build. Only its -with-generated-files tags count as versions
